rationale: The agent did attempt to identify and authenticate the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and looked up orders and a product. However, it performed order- and account-changing writes (modify_pending_order_items and modify_user_address) without any visible confirmation from the user, violating the policy to confirm before any order-changing action. It also did not address correcting order shipping addresses, nor hand off to a human if unable to perform that change. Additionally, there is no clear evidence that the replacement item is the “easiest with fewest pieces,” and no final confirmation of outcomes was provided. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
